sourceFile: 53.BRS-2015 Report Test MG-B Of Baotou NG Blistered Plating date 10.6.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable Baotou MG-B NG blistered plating versus Normal evidence exists, but the draft grouping and outcomes are not reliable enough for final use.
issues: Changed factor is a filename, not the actual Baotou NG plating vs Normal comparison.
Baseline and test conditions are marked unclear despite table context showing them.
Measurement outcomes are duplicated and misgrouped with generic column labels.
Decision results for separate glue, gauss, drop, and tension are not cited in outcomes.
Some key cited rows are not shown in context, limiting auditability.
correctionPlan: Set changed condition to Baotou MG-B NG blistered plating and baseline to Normal.
Keep supplier/material/coating as the changed-factor domain.
Regroup outcomes as separate glue, gauss, drop test, and tension under one validation report.
Use final decision rows for judgement: glue NG plating 7/12 at 58.3%, others OK, special-lot use allowed.
Replace generic detected-table metrics with named metrics and row-level citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations prove source existence but are insufficient for final evidence until outcome rows and decision rows are cited clearly.
